chunks: And among us are those who have submitted, and among us are those who are iniquitous; so those who have submitted have sought the right course.
ai.seo_question: How are the Jinn divided in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a microcosm of human history, where the 'Muslim' jinn represent the faithful who recognized the Prophet's mission, while the 'Qasitun' (deviant) symbolize those who resisted divine guidance. The phrase 'taharaw rashada' (sought the right path) underscores the active choice required for salvation, a concept central to Shia discussions on free will and the role of Imams as guides. This division mirrors the broader cosmic struggle between truth and falsehood, reinforcing the universality of the prophetic message across both human and jinn realms.
